ideas.idea: Back up the 'Integrates with all the tools' claim by naming the actual integrations
ideas.why: The home page makes a vague claim at _index.tsx:8, and naming the integrations gives readers and machines something concrete to understand.

ideas.idea: Show plan names, tiers or price ranges as text on the pricing page
ideas.why: pricing.tsx only says 'Talk to us for a quote', so the page has no content a visitor or machine can read about pricing.

ideas.idea: Link Features from the main navigation
ideas.why: root.tsx nav lists only Pricing and Changelog, and a real nav link would give crawlers a crawlable path to /features.
The sitemap has no lastmod, but this is a minor improvement that applies to almost any site.

ideas.idea: Date the changelog entries and give each its own page
ideas.why: Changelog entries are bare <li> strings with no dates or URLs, so adding dates and per-entry pages would make them easier to read and cite.
The deliberate choices say having no JSON-LD is not a required fix.

ideas.idea: Add charset and viewport meta tags in root.tsx
ideas.why: root.tsx doesn't set them, but this is standard boilerplate for any site and has little effect here.

ideas.idea: Expand the Features page with a short section on each feature
ideas.why: features.tsx has a single sentence, and more content per feature would give readers and machines something to understand and quote.

ideas.idea: Use <Link to="/features"> instead of the onClick div
ideas.why: This is the same as the known problem about /features being reached only by a div with onClick.
